item.title: Quincy Jones tops Forbes’ 2026 highest-paid deceased celebrities list at $150 million
item.description: Quincy Jones departed from this world in November 2024, but his legacy thrived, bringing in substantial revenue well into 2026. Much of this financial success stemmed from a remarkable $150 million deal for his extensive music catalog. Additionally, his enduring relationship with Michael Jackson fueled renewed interest following a blockbuster biopic's release.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 132-year-old Kirby home reduced to rubble
item.description: Houston's historic Kirby Mansion, a Tudor Revival gem, was abruptly leveled after city inspectors stopped renovation efforts over permit issues. Despite being well-maintained, the new owner proceeded with the demolition unauthorized, leading to outcry from preservationists. The community mourned the mansion with a vigil, pressing for policy reforms and alluding to a gas station development that might replace the beloved site.

item.title: Why neither MAGA nor Democrats are particularly bothered about Indian-Americans
item.description: About 133 years ago, a man born Narendranath said he was from India and preached tolerance at the World’s Parliament of Religions in a speech that evokes awe even today. It’s sad that, so many years later, Americans of all stripes have become particularly intolerant towards his descendants.
item.dc:creator: Nirmalya Dutta

item.title: Essex couple transform their garden with miniature railway
item.description: Dave and Angela Walker, a couple from Clacton-on-Sea, dedicated eight years to building a miniature railway. Their project spans approximately 400 metres throughout their quarter-acre garden, showcasing various collected memorabilia. Despite opinions from others, they find joy in their shared achievement and partnership. The couple plans to open their railway for community fundraising events benefiting the local lifeboat station.

item.title: UK High Court rules assets were gifted before death, orders £259,725 in legal costs
item.description: A High Court judge ruled that specific assets of the deceased were legitimate gifts received by Masudur Rahman before death, dating back to October 2020. This ruling ignited legal contention with four co-defendants. The court detailed the asset scope, allowing appeals on particular grounds. Rahman secured costs due to his successful claim, but his plea for an enhanced costs budget was ultimately denied by the judge.

item.title: Tennessee couple lose land claim after decades of mowing and gardening, court rules for developer
item.description: A couple from Tennessee faced a setback as their claim over a strip of land beside their house was overturned by the court. They believed their usage spanning almost 30 years sufficed for establishing ownership through adverse possession. However, the appeals court determined that the couple's evidence fell short of legal standards, highlighting a vital legal principle: merely using land for an extended period does not guarantee ownership.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger’s charity night raises record $9.75 million for US students
item.description: Arnold Schwarzenegger's yearly charity gala has made a remarkable impact, raising $9.75 million for After-School All-Stars. This initiative plays a crucial role in offering educational and extracurricular activities to around 150,000 students across the country. The event boasted live entertainment, auctions, and generous contributions from various artists and companies. For over 30 years, Schwarzenegger has dedicated himself to fostering educational and mentorship programs vital for youth development.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: James Patterson’s $220 million giving transforms literacy and education across the US
item.description: James Patterson has dedicated over $220 million to improve literacy and education in various sectors. His charitable contributions have resulted in more than 1,000 scholarships for students across the country. By providing support to educators, librarians, and independent bookstores, he recognizes their crucial roles in promoting reading. Patterson's focus is on enhancing literacy rather than just distributing books, tackling long-term educational obstacles to empower future generations.

item.title: US doctor reduces work hours to care for baby, court upholds higher income assessment
item.description: An Indiana doctor who reduced her working hours to care for her newborn daughter has lost her appeal after a court calculated her weekly earning capacity at $8,811, despite her reported income of $6,677. The Indiana Court of Appeals upheld the decision, finding that she was capable of working full-time. It also upheld an order allowing her former husband three overnight stays a week with their daughter.

item.title: Kai Cenat's unexpected TikTok money reveal steals the spotlight during LIVE with viral Michael Jackson impersonator
item.description: During an entertaining livestream with Looze Cannon, Kai Cenat unintentionally shared his impressive TikTok earnings, revealing a balance of $23,232.11. In addition, he earned between $7,000 and $7,300 from TikTok gifts throughout the 30-minute session. Looze Cannon, known for his entertaining Michael Jackson impersonations, kept the audience engaged with performances, making the unexpected financial revelation the highlight of their interaction.

item.title: 'We're out of time': Florida pilot's chilling last words before jet plunged to ground
item.description: A Learjet 60 tragically crashed in Palm Beach County, Florida, resulting in the deaths of nine individuals aboard. The pilot made urgent distress calls while reporting severe icing and turbulence shortly before the crash occurred. Descent rates reached alarming levels, culminating in a drop of up to 22,000 feet per minute. Investigations by the National Transportation Safety Board are focusing on weather conditions and possible structural failure.
item.dc:creator: Vijaya Srivastava

item.title: In 1610, one astronomer challenged Galileo’s discovery; their books survived together for centuries
item.description: In 1610, the revolutionary work of Galileo Galilei, titled Sidereus Nuncius, brought to light the moons orbiting Jupiter, challenging the traditional view of astronomy. This groundbreaking revelation incited controversy, notably with Francesco Sizzi, who dismissed these lunar discoveries as mere optical deceptions. Recently, a rare edition of Galileo's masterpiece fetched an astonishing Rs 2.07 crore, underscoring the enduring impact of his innovations amidst the scientific skepticism of his era.
